iran:air_defense_intercepts_7d.scope: UAE cumulative engagements through 27 March 2026: 378 ballistic missiles + 15 cruise missiles + 1,835 UAVs. Not confirmed interceptions or a region-wide total.

iran:critical_infrastructure_impacts_7d.scope: Iranian Red Crescent claim through 31 March 2026. Includes homes and commercial premises, not only critical infrastructure. Not independently verified.

ukraine:ukr_civilians_killed_reported.scope: Cumulative verified civilian deaths since 24 February 2022, as reported 13 August 2026. Excludes military deaths; actual total likely higher.

ukraine:ukr_civilians_injured_reported.scope: Cumulative verified civilian injuries since 24 February 2022, as reported 13 August 2026. Excludes military injuries; actual total likely higher.

iran:iran_killed.scope: 28 February-7 April 2026: 1,701 civilian, 1,221 military and 714 unclassified deaths. Not a September total.

iran:iran_injured.scope: Ministry total through 7 April, published by WHO on 16 April. Not independently verified or a September count.

iran:israel_killed.scope: First 40 days, ending at the April ceasefire. Includes fire from Iran and Lebanon and victims of different nationalities. Excludes combat abroad and indirect deaths.

iran:israel_injured.scope: Operation Roaring Lion cumulative hospital evacuations through 17 April, 07:00 local time. Broader than confirmed direct-strike wounds.

iran:us_killed.scope: Combined Operation Epic Fury and subsequent Overseas Operations tally. Includes operational deaths, not only hostile-fire deaths.

iran:us_seriously_injured.scope: Epic Fury and Overseas Operations combined. Replaces the incorrect seriously-injured label. Not a September live count.

iran:missiles_total_2026.scope: UAE only: 537 ballistic plus 26 cruise missiles since the conflict began. Replaces the unsupported regional launch total; not impact sites.

iran:drones_total_2026.scope: UAE cumulative claim. Replaces the unsupported region-wide drone launch count. Does not establish individual map locations.

iran:air_strikes_total_2026.scope: 28 February-7 September. Location/day events include air, missile and drone attacks, including interceptions; not individual weapons or solely airstrikes.

ukraine:russia_killed_reported.scope: Estimated range for February 2022-June 2026. Not a named-person verified count or September total.

ukraine:russia_injured_reported.scope: February 2022-June 2026; includes killed, wounded and missing. Replaces the unsupported wounded-only count. Deaths are already included; do not add the cards.

ukraine:ukraine_strike_incidents_7d.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Event counts, not individual weapons.

ukraine:critical_infra_impacts_7d_ua.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Attack events, not unique damaged facilities.

ukraine:frontline_pressure_index.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Replaces the unsupported pressure index with a documented event count.

ukraine:ukraine_displaced_population_m.scope: People displaced within Ukraine as of 30 June. Excludes refugees abroad; displayed in people, not millions.

ukraine:ukraine_energy_sites_damaged_30d.scope: 29 August-4 September 2026. Replaces the unsupported 30-day damaged-site count; events can affect the same site more than once.
